newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Rugby union-Unbeaten Blues sail to Super 12 final.
newsitem.headline: Rugby union-Unbeaten Blues sail to Super 12 final.

text.p: The Auckland Blues maintained their incredible unbeaten run in this year's Super 12 rugby by trouncing the Natal Sharks 55-36 in Saturday's semifinal at Auckland's Eden Park.

A clinical, blistering first half performance saw the defending champions 33-5 clear at halftime. Although Natal produced a stirring late fightback, the Blues were always cruising to victory and a home final next weekend.
